---
name: Transcription problem
about: Missing notes, extra notes, wrong pitch or timing
labels: accuracy
---

**What went wrong**
Missing notes / extra notes / wrong octave / timing / note length (pick one or more).

**Where**
Rough time position in the recording (for example 1:12 to 1:20) and the notes involved.

**Recording**
Piano type (grand, upright, digital, sampled), room (dry, reverb, live hall), format and length.
If you can share a short clip (under 30 s) that reproduces it, please attach it.

**Settings**
Sensitivity and note-length options used, platform (web browser / Android) and app version.
